subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR require real full-runner or gateway proof before merge, or is the temporary predicate-script transcript plus fault-injected tests sufficient for the retry/session/delivery change?
rationale: The code shape looks like the right boundary, but the change is delivery- and session-state-sensitive and the current contributor evidence does not prove the real runtime path after the fix.

options.title: Require real runtime proof
options.body: Ask for redacted full-runner or gateway terminal output/logs showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicate side effects before merge.

options.title: Accept the current proof
options.body: Treat the temporary predicate-script transcript and fault-injected tests as sufficient and handle remaining risk through maintainer review and CI after conflict resolution.

options.title: Choose another canonical PR
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer a cleaner open candidate such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 for the same issue.

recommendation.title: Require real runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted full-runner or gateway terminal output/logs showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicate side effects before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged and closed the adjacent retry fix and is the clearest available routing candidate for proof sufficiency and retry semantics.
